QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Cantor Knows
QuestInfo.0: The princess testifies about what happened that day. Go see Cantor who accompanied the king to the end.
QuestInfo.1: You meet Cantor, the masked musician, who always seem to be happy. He was the priest who survived the top secret area. You listen to him talk about that day with difficulty as he wants to be free from those memories.
QuestInfo.2: You met Cantor, the musician in the mask. He talked about the disappearance of Subject No. 618 and the king.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  56,039,250
Can proceed to [Kritias] The Truth Behind Kritias

0.0: Seeing you here means you have gotten to the heart of the matter.\r\n#L0# #bYou gave the testimony of Parma, Hirrel, Blundell, and the princess.#l\n#k
0.1: Haha... You mean... What happened that day?

yes.0: After all, it would be even stranger if no one questioned when something like this happened.

1.0: Yes, I am the priest who bore witness to the experiments alongside His Majesty, Hekaton. That terrible underground prison, the countless monsters trapped there... Subject No. 618...\r\n#L0# #bAre you okay? You're shaking...#l\n#k
1.1: I'm sorry. I can't bring myself to recall all the horrors I saw. I just want to live a new life behind this cheerful mask.\r\n#L0# #bThe cause for all this was... the incident there?#l\n#k
1.2: I can't go into details, but... yes. His Majesty, Hekaton, didn't go missing.\r\n#L0# #bHe didn't?#l\n#k
1.3: I saw it all. He evacuated the room, 'vanished,' and then Trueffet rose.\r\n#L0# #bWait, all of this wasn't because of the Black Mage's invasion?#l\n#k
1.4: Quite the opposite. The pentacle surrounding Kritias is the magic of His Majesty, Hekaton. Our failure is what brought the Black Mage to us. Or perhaps, because of Subject No. 618...\r\n#L0# #bSubject No. 618? Who is that?#l\n#k
1.5: A mysterious being called the 'omen of disaster.' His Majesty, Hekaton, wanted to use them to achieve eternal life.\r\n#L0# #bThat's crazy...#l\n#k
1.6: Indeed. It was that crazed drive that has brought Kritias to its current state.\r\n#L0# #bWhere is Subject No. 618?#l\n#k
1.7: I don't know. They were there, and then they were not. It's why His Majesty's ritual failed, allowing the Black Mage to invade in the midst of the chaos. By the time I came to my senses, Subject No. 618 was gone and things were as they are now.\r\n#L0# #bCould you tell me any more about what happened that day?#l\n#k
1.8: I dare not speak of it any further. Hopefully, I've given you enough to go on. Perhaps one day I'll be able to speak about it in full...

yes.0: The me that was there that day is gone. Now I am Cantor, and I want to live my simple life.
